text_block_list.text:
Returning to the front of the station, I 
ran into Cesario and the others holding 
shopping bags.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat!? It's so unfair you three are 
going out together! I wanna hang out too!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu. Oh no, it wasn't for fun. I just 
finished running an errand for the dorm 
mother.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Then let's go hang out now! You come too, 
Trainer! Pretty please? Huh?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Even if I say no, you won't listen, will 
you? Good grief, I guess I have no choice.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Let's drop off our bags first, and 
then go hang out together properly!
choice_data_list: Sorry, everyone.
Sorry, everyone.

text_block_list.text:
She's been working hard at her training 
lately. ...In that case, let's make today 
all about doing whatever she wants.
choice_data_list: 悪いな、みんな
悪いね、みんな

text_block_list.text:
“—Time for the third song! I'm not letting 
go of this mic yet~♡”

Clapping along to the music, I watch over 
her, thinking she's really going all out.
